note: Percentile ranges, stop-hit rates and level frequencies measured over the sample each series actually has. These are frequencies in past data, not forecasts.

cautions.past_only: Every figure is a frequency in past data. It says what happened, not what will.
cautions.sample: The sample size is published beside every figure. A stock with 400 sessions and one with 2,000 are not equally informative.
cautions.touch_vs_finish: Touching a level is roughly twice as likely as finishing beyond it, because a price can touch and come back. The two are shown separately for that reason.
